itens.resumo: Ivanti Connect Secure contains a missing authentication for critical function vulnerability that could allow a local authenticated attacker to escalate their privileges. This vulnerability can be chained with CVE-2026-104935 and CVE-2026-118527.

itens.titulo: GHSA-4xm8-rg9h-jhq2: Signal K resources API path traversal can disclose the JWT signing secret and enable remote code execution
itens.resumo: Path traversal in the Signal K resources and applicationData APIs lets an unauthenticated or low-privileged user read, write and delete files outside the storage root. itens.titulo: GHSA-hff9-5pqw-6w9f: imgproxy has integer overflow in imgproxy ICO loader that causes denial of service and may permit remote code execution
itens.resumo: The ICO loader allocates data_size + BMP_FILE_HEADER_LEN bytes after reading a 32-bit attacker-controlled data_size . For data_size UINT32_MAX - BMP_FILE_HEADER_LEN , the addition wraps before allocation. imgproxy then writes the ICO prefix and reads up to the original declared size starting 14 bytes into the undersized allocation. A network client can turn this heap overflow into remote denial of service or remote code execution. itens.titulo: CVE-2026-119706: InternLM LMDeploy 0.9.0 through 0.18.0 contains an unauthenticated remote code execution vulnerability that allows remote attackers to run OS…
itens.resumo: InternLM LMDeploy 0.9.0 through 0.18.0 contains an unauthenticated remote code execution vulnerability that allows remote attackers to run OS commands by sending pickled data to the /update_weights endpoint. Attackers can submit a base64-encoded crafted pickle in serialized_named_tensors, which ForkingPickler.loads deserializes without validation, executing commands as the api_server process.

itens.titulo: A Shared ChatGPT Link Could Run Attacker Code in Your Session and Read Private Chats
itens.resumo: A malicious ChatGPT share link could run an attacker's code in the logged-in session of anyone who opened it, allowing them to read their private conversations, researchers at the security firm Parameter showed. The researchers reported the flaw through OpenAI's bug bounty program on October 18, and OpenAI fixed it eight days later and rated it P1, its most serious category.

Cape explains how these attacks exploit trust between networks and how its security-focused mobile service helps defend against them. [...]
